A visit to the Al Safa Park 2 in Dubai is well worth the time and effort. OK,  Really nice grounds that were immaculately kept and great views of the city skyline.
There is a modest entrance fee is Free  and they do ‎maintenance of the park in general.
My wife and I were there to watch our two grand sons in a soccer practice and while we were ‎enjoying the boys practice there were many other people simply enjoying the park by having a food ‎in a designated area or simply walking through the green park. ‎
If you truly want to escape from the hustle-and-bustle of the sometimes frantic life style in Dubai an ‎hour walk within the Safa Park may be your best remedy!‎
